title: BossFile
description: One boss: budget, stages and move table (architecture section 4, content/bosses). Which fields a boss needs depends on its behaviour: caffeine uses stage2Budget to moves, toast uses song and workOrder. Rules the schema cannot state (the fields of each behaviour, telegraph lengths per tier, live windows no longer than the dodge i-frames, the summoned enemy existing) are checked in core/combat/bosses/boss.ts.

id.description: Matches the boss field of the enemy in content/enemies.json.

behaviour.description: Which core controller runs this boss.

concedeDialogue.description: The conversation that opens when his case is closed (toast: when his budget runs out). Required for toast, optional for caffeine; it sets whatever lets the chapter go on.

budget.description: Annual budget, the boss's health (design doc 5.8).

stage2Budget.description: Stage 2 starts once the budget falls to this.

speedTiles.description: Walking speed in tiles per second before caffeine.

rangeTiles.description: Preferred distance from the operator, [near, far] in tiles.

restSeconds.description: Pause between moves before caffeine; caffeine shortens it.

powerCutSeconds.description: How long the stage-3 power cut holds the boss still.

notes.description: Provenance of the numbers (DOC, ASSUME), as in content/params.json.

BossSong.description: Toast: the song of 乾杯三巡 (design doc 7.7). Each round sings its lines, one ring of toast waves per line, then breathes; after the last round the last one repeats.

wakeTiles.description: He waits, silent, until the operator comes this close; the room's intro conversation should fire before that.

introSeconds.description: From waking to the first line.

rounds.description: At most three, one per stage of the nameplate.

breathSeconds.description: The breath after each round's last line, his weak point.

lines.description: Lines sung this round, one wave each.

beatSeconds.description: From one wave to the next; longer than the 0.5 s tier-1 telegraph, so each line's warning plays out before the next begins.

shots.description: Shots evenly round the ring, one aimed at the operator.

cups.description: Cups one landed wave adds to the liver's receiving area.

BossWorkOrder.description: Toast: alcohol work orders on the operator from the moment he wakes until he concedes, breaths included, one per cup waiting in receiving.

refillDelaySeconds.description: Stage 1: how long the residue stays under the boost threshold before the next cup.

burstCups.description: Cups drunk back to back on entering stage 2 and after each power cut.

tolerantFromCup.description: From this cup on the boost is the tolerant one (design doc 7.4: the third).

max.description: Most summoned enemies alive at once.

tier.description: Warning tier (design doc 5.3): 1 throws shots, 2 marks an area at the operator, 3 is a proposal around the boss.

shots.description: Tier 1: shots per throw, fanned around the aim.

rangeTiles.description: Tier 1: how far a shot flies.

radiusTiles.description: Tier 2 and 3: radius of the area.

activeTicks.description: Tier 2 and 3: ticks the area stays live after the telegraph.
